scope: One adaptive exploratory TRAIN-only last-layer adaptation; prior TRAIN results informed this hypothesis. Not independent validation or a semantic detector

inputs.split: Original unchanged TRAIN only; exact contents deduplicated; all views/windows stay in source group

model.source: Existing verified commercial-use XCLIP artifact and unchanged pinned processor/windows
model.initialization: A normal std 1/sqrt(2048), B zero; fixed seed
model.prefix: Capture fc2 input/output, pre-layer_norm2 residual and outer MIT input; reproduce fp16 residual additions and pooling before normalization
model.activation_recomputation: Only final linear delta, two original residual additions, pooling, normalization and head; no approximated mean-input replacement

replay.failure_policy: Stop before training. Preserve aggregate reproducibility failure. A repair requires a new source-registration revision and cannot be reported as ML quality

views.augmentation: PIL Brightness 0.9 then Contrast 1.1, same factors on every frame; original PTS/order/labels preserved
views.train_sampling: Alternate all original videos and all augmented videos by optimizer step; no per-video selection

projection.fit: Existing equal-video weighted PCA fitted solely to ORIGINAL historical features of train-fold videos; fixed during adapter training; no held group inputs

head.checkpoint: Last iterate only; no early stopping, search, seed choice or rerun

adapter_optimizer.anchor: Equal-video mean squared L2 distance of normalized adapted embeddings from normalized zero-adapter embeddings; valid windows only; current training view only

supervision.positive: Existing BCE at nearest original center to nonexhaustive official point; other positive windows context only
supervision.negative: Existing BCE on maximum valid logit of each negative video

evaluation.method: Leave one whole unchanged TRAIN group out
comparators: unchanged cosine baseline on historical original features
same regularized head/views/steps with zero adapter frozen

gates.point: Nonregression of all-positive candidate-point MAE and common-TP paired MAE versus cosine baseline, both separately; no comparison of different TP cohorts

retention: New prefix/adapter artifacts and per-video outputs private; safe technical aggregates only outward. Preserve original videos, caches, split, baseline and research UI8768. No credentials, system changes or foreign process cleanup
final_fit: One additional fixed fullTRAIN fit per matched control and adapter arm after all CV; save private adapter pack even if rejected, clearly in-sample and release_eligible=false; no service promotion
stop: One registered bounded attempt. Any replay/resource failure stops before later phases. Failed quality gates preserved; no TUNE/HOLDOUT, cloud inference, audio, faces, filename answers, legal/type invention, or grid search
